item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 23/Feb/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the winter monsoon, it will remain cold over Guangdong in the morning in the next couple of days. The monsoon is expected to moderate gradually in the latter part of this week. It will be generally fine with temperatures rising progressively, and the temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large over the coastal areas of Guangdong. An easterly airstream will affect the coast of southern China in the early and middle parts of next week. There will be sunny intervals over the region.
